title: Welcome!
text: Hi, I'm Mayor Pip! Let me show you around Abderrahmane's island. Every place here is a piece of their portfolio. It only takes a minute.

title: The Cozy House
text: This is where Abderrahmane lives. Inside you'll find their story, hobbies and what they're looking for next.

title: The Workshop
text: Every booth out front is a project, with screenshots, links and the tech behind it.

title: The Skill Garden
text: Each plant is a skill. The taller it grows, the more it's been practised.

title: Memory Lane
text: Follow the signposts to walk through the journey so far: studies, jobs and milestones.

title: Radio Hill
text: Want to get in touch? Drop a letter in the mailbox and it goes straight to Abderrahmane's inbox.

title: The Old Dock
text: Last stop! Fish from the end of the dock, take the boat out, or just enjoy the view. There are secrets hidden all over the island. Have fun exploring!
